gates.name: Test (build.yml, .NET job)
gates.detail: dotnet test --no-build --configuration Release --verbosity normal: Total tests: 265, Passed: 264, Failed: 1. SubZeroDev.Platform.Tests.WorkerProbeTests.The_worker_serves_its_probes_on_loopback_and_nowhere_else failed on both the full run and re-run in isolation: 'System.Net.Sockets.SocketException : nodename nor servname provided, or not known' at WorkerProbeTests.cs:100, inside BoundOnAnyNonLoopbackAddress -> System.Net.Dns.GetHostAddresses. This is a DNS/hostname resolution failure in this local sandboxed environment (cannot resolve the machine's own hostname to a non-loopback address), not an assertion about the code under test; ubuntu-latest CI runners resolve their own hostname and would not necessarily hit this. Reported as a real failure of this local run, with the caveat that its cause looks environment-specific rather than a defect this PR introduced -- this PR touches only design/ file locations, not networking or hosting code.

gates.name: Validate design/30-slices.md's Status markers (docs-ci.yml)
gates.detail: pwsh ./build/Test-SliceStatusMarkers.ps1: 'SKIP: no active slices document at .../design/30-slices.md -- the active effort has no slices yet.' Exit code 0. This is the script's own documented, intended behavior (per its own comment block): 'Between the commit that archives a finished effort's set and the /slices run that writes the next one, the active effort has a brief and no slices -- stage 0 of the pipeline, not a broken repository', and a missing document at the default path passes with a stated skip rather than failing. This branch's own commit message ('Archive G2's design set to design/g2/, leaving the root at stage 0') is exactly this designed state, so the SKIP-as-pass here is the correct, expected outcome of this PR, not a gap.

gates.name: Build and verify the status-page site (docs-ci.yml verify job)
gates.detail: npm --prefix site ci && npm --prefix site run check: format:check, lint, and typecheck all passed. The 'test' step (vitest run --config vitest.config.ts) failed: 'FAIL src/roadmap/roadmapData.test.ts [ src/roadmap/roadmapData.test.ts ] Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open /Users/ben/Dropbox/Projects/SubZeroDev.Platform/design/30-slices.md' at roadmapData.test.ts:219, in the describe block "the active design/30-slices.md -- the assertion that survives every future merge", which does 'const activeRaw = readFileSync(join(..., "design", "30-slices.md"), "utf8")' against the repo root. Test Files: 1 failed | 5 passed (6); Tests: 40 passed (40, since the failing file threw before any of its own tests ran). This exactly confirms the known risk called out for this PR: this test hard-reads the root design/30-slices.md, which this branch moves to design/g2/30-slices.md, so the file no longer exists at that path. npm run check exited 1 overall (test:build and test:merge were not reached because 'test' failed first, per npm's default fail-fast chaining with &&).
